Paste a tree as JSON
Format: {"solutions":[{"pubkey","nonces":[...],"miningSeed","anchorTickDigest","anchorTick","finalScore","maxDepth"}]}. Nonces run root-first; solutions that share a prefix are merged into one tree.
cold hot | white ring = changed this step | arrow = data flow into the reader; selected neuron: yellow in, cyan out | red = shared link, dashed = duplicated input
square = solution: [s=shift lower bound] error / mode(S start, W wiring, T LUTs) L K depth  |  yellow = best  |  red dashed = rejected  |  wheel zoom, drag pan, click = details
Click a node to see its solution data.
